```{r}
library(thekidsbiostats)
library(scales)
library(knitr)

payload <- readRDS(params$payload_rds)

balance_numeric <- payload$balance_numeric
balance_categorical <- payload$balance_categorical
dat <- payload$combined
vars <- payload$vars
var_type_map <- payload$var_type_map

comparison_group <- if (is.null(payload$comparison_group)) "Those not sampled" else payload$comparison_group
comparison_label <- if (identical(comparison_group, "Everyone")) "Everyone" else "Not included"

if (nrow(balance_numeric) > 0) {
  balance_numeric <- balance_numeric %>%
    rename(
      !!paste0("Missing % (", comparison_label, ")") := missing_not_included,
      !!paste0("Mean (", comparison_label, ")") := mean_not_included
    )
}

if (nrow(balance_categorical) > 0) {
  balance_categorical <- balance_categorical %>%
    rename(
      !!paste0("Missing % (", comparison_label, ")") := missing_not_included
    )
}
```


```{r}
make_var_plot <- function(dat, var_name, var_type = NULL) {
  x <- dat[[var_name]]
  resolved_type <- if (!is.null(var_type)) var_type else if (is.numeric(x)) "numeric" else "categorical"
  
  if (resolved_type == "numeric") {
    dat <- dat %>%
      mutate(.x = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(.data[[var_name]]))))
    ggplot(dat, aes(x = .x, fill = .included)) +
      geom_density(alpha = 0.35, na.rm = TRUE) +
      labs(x = var_name, y = "Density", fill = "") +
      theme_thekids() +
      scale_fill_thekids() +
      scale_colour_thekids()
  } else if (resolved_type == "date") {
    dat <- dat %>%
      mutate(.x = as.Date(.data[[var_name]]))

    ggplot(dat, aes(x = .x, fill = .included)) +
      geom_histogram(position = "identity", alpha = 0.5, binwidth = 90, na.rm = TRUE) +
      labs(x = var_name, y = "Count", fill = "") +
      scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b %Y") +
      theme_thekids() +
      scale_fill_thekids() +
      scale_colour_thekids()
  } else {
    dat2 <- dat %>%
      mutate(.x = as.factor(.data[[var_name]]))
    
    ggplot(dat2, aes(x = .included, fill = .x)) +
      geom_bar(position = "fill") +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
      labs(x = var_name, y = "Proportion", fill = "") +
      theme_thekids() +
      scale_fill_thekids() +
      scale_colour_thekids()
  }
}
```

```{r}
make_var_summary <- function(dat, var_name, var_type = NULL) {
  x <- dat[[var_name]]
  resolved_type <- if (!is.null(var_type)) var_type else if (is.numeric(x)) "numeric" else "categorical"
  
  if (resolved_type == "numeric") {
    dat2 <- dat %>%
      mutate(.x = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(.data[[var_name]]))))

    stats_by_group <- dat2 %>%
      group_by(.included) %>%
      summarise(
        Mean = mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        SD = sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        Median = median(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        Min = suppressWarnings(min(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
        Max = suppressWarnings(max(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        Min = if_else(is.infinite(Min), NA_real_, Min),
        Max = if_else(is.infinite(Max), NA_real_, Max)
      )

    tibble::tibble(Statistic = c("Mean", "SD", "Median", "Min", "Max")) %>%
      left_join(
        stats_by_group %>%
          tidyr::pivot_longer(
            cols = c(Mean, SD, Median, Min, Max),
            names_to = "Statistic",
            values_to = "Value"
          ) %>%
          mutate(Value = round(Value, 2)) %>%
          tidyr::pivot_wider(
            names_from = .included,
            values_from = Value
          ),
        by = "Statistic"
      )
  } else {
    dat2 <- dat %>%
      mutate(.x = as.factor(.data[[var_name]]))
    
    dat2 %>%
      count(.included, .x) %>%
      group_by(.included) %>%
      mutate(Percent = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1)) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      mutate(`N(%)` = paste0(n, " (", Percent, "%)")) %>%
      rename(Level = .x) %>%
      tidyr::pivot_wider(
        names_from = .included,
        values_from = `N(%)`,
        names_glue = "N(%) ({.included})"
      ) %>%
      arrange(Level)
    
  }
}
```

## Snapshot

```{r}
cat("Generated on:", format(payload$generated_on), "\n")
cat("ID variable:", payload$id_var, "\n")
cat("Compared to:", comparison_label, "\n")
cat("Drilldowns included:", isTRUE(payload$include_drilldowns), "\n")
```

## Overview

### Numeric Variables

```{r}
if (nrow(balance_numeric) == 0) {
cat("No numeric variables available.\n")
} else {
  balance_numeric %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      variable,
      mean_included,
      mean_comparison = mean_not_included,
      p_ttest,
      p_wilcox
    ) %>%
    dplyr::rename(
      `Mean (Included)` = mean_included,
      !!paste0("Mean (", comparison_label, ")") := mean_comparison,
      `t-test p` = p_ttest,
      `wilcox p` = p_wilcox
    ) %>%
    thekids_table(colour = "MidnightBlue", padding = 0.2)
}
```

### Categorical Variables

```{r}
if (nrow(balance_categorical) == 0) {
cat("No categorical variables available.\n")
} else {
  balance_categorical %>%
    dplyr::transmute(variable, n_levels, p_value) %>%
    dplyr::rename(`# levels` = n_levels, `Fisher p` = p_value) %>%
    thekids_table(colour = "MidnightBlue", padding = 0.2)
}
```

## Missingness

```{r}
missing_tbl <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  balance_numeric %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      variable,
      type = "Numeric",
      missing_included,
      missing_comparison = missing_not_included
    ),
  balance_categorical %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      variable,
      type = "Categorical/Date",
      missing_included,
      missing_comparison = missing_not_included
    )
) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    `Missing % (Included)` = missing_included,
    !!paste0("Missing % (", comparison_label, ")") := missing_comparison
  )

if (nrow(missing_tbl) == 0) {
  cat("No variables available.\n")
} else {
  missing_tbl %>%
    thekids_table(colour = "MidnightBlue", padding = 0.2)
}
```

## Drilldowns

```{r}
if (!isTRUE(payload$include_drilldowns)) {
  cat("Drilldowns not included.\n")
} else if (length(vars) == 0) {
  cat("No variables selected for drilldown.\n")
} else {
  for (v in vars) {
    cat("\n\n## ", v, "\n", sep = "")
    var_type <- if (!is.null(var_type_map)) var_type_map[[v]] else NULL
    print(make_var_plot(dat, v, var_type = var_type))
    cat("\n\n")
    make_var_summary(dat, v, var_type = var_type) %>%
      thekids_table(colour = "MidnightBlue", padding = 0.2)
  }
}
```
